candidates.note_zh: 深海军蓝底配高亮青蓝，系统结构清晰，最符合技术答辩与工程可信感。
candidates.note_en: Deep navy with cyan highlights for architecture clarity and engineering credibility.

candidates.note_en: Cool white and navy for dependable projection and academic readability.

candidates.note_en: Charcoal, ice blue, and signal orange for a stronger developer-keynote tone.
